forces: ⚠️ deciduous CONIFER, needle/scale foliage (coverageGaps: scale) + deciduous-conifer season ramp
descriptor: Pyramidal deciduous conifer; soft feathery needle sprays, sage-green in summer, rusty-copper in fall, then BARE in winter; buttressed/fluted trunk; reddish fibrous bark.
identityNotes: A conifer that goes BARE in winter. Soft needle-like leaves in flat, two-ranked feathery sprays. Trunk strongly buttressed/fluted at the flared base; 'knees' only near standing water (a park-lawn specimen usually lacks them). Botanically NEEDLE-like (linear), not broad scale.

referenceImages.caption: Pyramidal habit with feathery soft-green foliage; buttressed trunk base.
Rusty coppery-orange autumn foliage of the feathery needle sprays.
